answers.basic: Yes, I use them on the subway and when I want to listen to something without disturbing anyone. They're also handy for work calls. On a noisy train, I can follow an English recording much more easily once I've put my earbuds in.

questions.prompt: What type of headphones do you use?

answers.basic: I mostly use wireless earbuds because they're easy to carry. For a longer call at home, I sometimes use a headset with a microphone. The earbuds fit in a small pocket in my bag, so I usually have them even when I've left the bigger headset at home.

I use them to listen to music on my way to work or to take a call. Sometimes I put on an English recording during a walk. A walk is a good time to play the same short clip a couple of times and listen for phrases I've missed.

questions.prompt: In what conditions would you not use headphones?

answers.basic: I take them out when I'm cycling or crossing a busy road. I also leave them off when I'm coaching so I can hear the players. On court I often need to hear a question from the other side of the net, even while people are playing nearby.

They're comfortable for a short trip. If I wear earbuds for too long, my ears start to feel tired, so I take them out for a while. I notice it most after a long call, when taking them out for five minutes feels like a proper break.
